source_evidence.evidence: Contemporaneous 8 June 2015 report states the Thomas a Becket pub freehold was offered by Savills at the Millennium Hotel, Grosvenor Square on Monday 22 June 2015 with guide GBP1.9m; source quotes the auction catalogue and redevelopment/reconfiguration potential.

Contemporaneous day archive records the Thomas a Becket lot as withdrawn from the auction and separately records a council-owned shop and flat in Southwark Bridge Road selling at the Savills auction for GBP1.1m against GBP500k guide.
Surviving Savills London & National Residential & Commercial addendum identifies 22 June 2015 as the forthcoming auction date.

reconciliation.expected_lots_basis: Previously banked first-party Savills archive manifest for 22 June 2015; retained as auction-level reconciliation target.
